description: Where an advanced search can run — the US and its territories for now. With no arguments: the US and its territories (Puerto Rico, Guam …), with their codes. With country 'US': its states and their codes. With q: US places whose name contains q, with their codes and states — for run_advanced_search's places, or search_leads' location_code.

q.description: Part of a place's name, at least 2 characters.

name: find_places

countries.description: With no arguments: the US and its territories, each { code, name, region, places }.

places.description: With country 'US' alone: how many places it has. With q: the matches, each { code, name, region } (up to 50).

region.description: With country 'US' alone: what its regions are called (state).

regions.description: With country 'US' alone: each state, { code, name, places }.

total_matching.description: With q: every match, of which up to 50 are listed.

title: Find US states and places
